{"id":1535069295,"question_id":3434,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1738953305,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"114 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1535069295/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Number of Distinct Colors Among the Balls","memory":"155.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n     vector<int> queryResults(int limit, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        int n=queries.size();\n        unordered_map<int,int> color_freq;\n        unordered_map<int,int> ball_color;\n        vector<int> res(n);\n\n        for(int i=0;i<n;i++)\n        {\n            int ball = queries[i][0];\n            int color = queries[i][1];\n            //Remove a color if the chosen ball was already painted\n            if(ball_color.count(ball))\n            {\n                //Reduce frequency of color of the ball to be re-painted\n                color_freq[ball_color[ball]]--;\n\n                if(color_freq[ball_color[ball]] == 0)\n                    color_freq.erase(ball_color[ball]);\n            }\n            //Paint the ball with given color\n            ball_color[ball]=color;\n            // increase the colour freq\n            color_freq[color]++;\n\n            res[i] = color_freq.size();\n        }\n        return res;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-number-of-distinct-colors-among-the-balls","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":299}
